The '''Ryndellian sector''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] along the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], east of [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Enarc system/Legends|Enarc]]. It contained at least four [[Star system/Legends|systems]] and five [[Planet/Legends|planets]] as well as a spin-off of the Triellus: the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]]. Having been explored during the two millennia preceding the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], it became part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], although some of its territory became unaligned in the [[New Sith Wars]].

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the sector was in Republic hands, in close proximity to [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. In the [[21 BBY/Legends|second year]] of the war, the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]] hosted the [[Battle of the Ryndellia system/Legends|Battle of the Ryndellia system]] and the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] due to a Separatist attempt to destroy an important [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|medical station]] with their new [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. The sector would not see more incursions in the conflict.

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], a secondary force of [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] raiders advanced along the Triellus Trade Route, reaching as far as [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]]. The [[Thrawn campaign]] of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] also saw [[Thrawn's confederation|Imperial]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] conquering the sector and moving towards [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]] and [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]]. The region remained untouched by the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Swarm War]] and the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] and came under the rule of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] by [[137 ABY]].

==Description==
The Ryndellian [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] south, in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] portion of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]],<ref name="EAOC" /> along the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]]. It contained at least four [[Star system/Legends|systems]]&mdash;[[Farstine system/Legends|Farstine]], [[Regulgo system/Legends|Regulgo]] and [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia]]<ref name="EAOC" />&mdash;and the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Ryndellia/Legends|Ryndellia]], [[Farstine]], [[Ninzam VI]] and [[Kaliida Shoals/Legends|Kaliida Shoals]].<ref name="EAOC" /><ref name="rant">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30376893|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2009-08-24|time=8:34 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802103104/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-100}}</ref> It was bordered by the [[Iskin sector/Legends|Iskin sector]] at its [[Galactic Center|coreward]] boundary, with the other neighbors being&mdash;clockwise&mdash;the [[Far Xandil sector/Legends|Far Xandil]], [[Vendusii sector/Legends|Vendusii]], [[Cadavine sector/Legends|Cadavine]], [[Juris sector/Legends|Juris]], [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra]] and [[Alui sector/Legends|Alui]] sectors, respectively.<ref name="EAOC" />

The [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]]&mdash;the most notable trade route of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]&mdash;passed through the sector, entering from the Cadavine sector and ending west at [[Enarc/Legends|Enarc]] in the Alui sector. The [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]] branched off the Triellus at [[Farstine]], heading towards the Juris sector and eventually reaching [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]], its terminus.<ref name="TEA" /> At the southern boundary of the sector, near the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]] was the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]], stretching into the Outer Rim.<ref name="EAOC" /><ref name="TEA" />

Circa [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], most of the population was concentrated along the Triellus route, with averagely 100 million to 500 million inhabitants living on inhabited worlds along the corridor. The average population on planets in the immediate vicinity of Farstine and on Farstine itself was 500 million to 1 billion. In some other areas of the sector, this number could go as low as 1 million to 10 million or 10 million to 100 million.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
===Exploration and Galactic Republic===
The tract of space containing the territory of the future zone was explored between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], though most of the neighboring [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] had been known by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5500 BBY/Legends|5500 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> It became part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and some of its territory became unaligned in the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="TEA" />

Following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and her escort raced across the sector towards [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to avoid [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] pickets.<ref name="TEA" />

With the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="dates">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}}</ref><ref name="TEA" /> the territory of the Ryndellian sector, which the Republic regained by then, became close to [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="TEA" /> The same year, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] traveled along the Triellus Trade Route to investigate the truth behind the [[Force vision/Legends|Force visions]] of [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|her mother's]] torture.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="swa-2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref><ref name="TEA" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|the second year]] of the war,<ref name="swa-2011" /> the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]]<ref name="som" /> and the neighborhood of [[Kaliida Shoals/Legends|Kaliida Shoals]]<ref name="TEA" /> were the site of [[Battle of the Ryndellia system/Legends|two]] [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|battles]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="som" />&mdash;whom the area was aligned to<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']],<ref name="som" /> a Separatist [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|heavy cruiser]]<ref name="cg">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> armed with two [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]],<ref name="vg">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> attempted to destroy a key [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Republic medical center]]<ref name="som" /> treating 60,000<ref name="med-db">{{DB|location|kaliidashoals|Kaliida Shoals Med Center}}</ref> injured [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], but failed due to the efforts of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]].<ref name="som" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="dates" /> the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] was temporarily relocated to [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], traveling through the region in the process. Later, [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] ship&mdash;the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']]&mdash;also crossed the area while en route from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] to pick up [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] outside the [[Utapau system/Legends|Utapau system]]. Kenobi also traversed it while transporting the newborn [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] from [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Galactic Empire and beyond===
By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Ryndellian sector had been in existence.<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="dates" /> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Fleet/Legends|task force]], [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], passed through the system when it was moving from [[Qeimet system/Legends|Qeimet]] to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to rout the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Army/Legends|forces]] present there.<ref name="TEA" /> [[4 ABY/Legends|A year later]],<ref name="dates" /> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] sped across the Ryndellian to deliver a [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]&ndash;entombed [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to Tatooine after outwitting a team of [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] in the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] raiders advanced along the Triellus Trade Route in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] as part of the [[Nagai–Tof War]], passing through the sector and getting as far as [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[9 ABY/Legends|Five years later]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] forces launched attacks on [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]] and [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]] from here, capturing the sector in the process.<ref name="TEA" /> No battles were fought in the region during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Swarm War]] and the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TEA" />

By [[137 ABY]], the sector was controlled by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
===Native species===
[[File:Draag-1.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A Draag.]]

====Draag====
{{Main|Draag}}
The Draag were [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Ninzam VI. Due to their cold-blooded biology, they were forced to wear temperature-regulating body suits when leaving their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Members of the species were bipedal, had four nostrils and horns.<ref name="cswe-dr" />

===Immigrated species===
The Galactic Republic established the Kaliida Shoals Medical Center for clone troopers injured during the Clone Wars. This station cured 60,000 [[Human/Legends|Human]] patients<ref name="med-db" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="swa-2011" /> and was overseen by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Nala Se/Legends|Nala Se]].<ref name="med-db" /> The same year, the Confederate [[General/Legends|general]] Grievous&mdash;a [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] who had been reconstructed as a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] after a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] accident secretly orchestrated by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>&mdash;launched an assault on the facility with his superweapon, the ''Malevolence'', but the attack ended with his defeat.<ref name="som" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ryndellian sector first appeared in an extra map of ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion]]'' on [[StarWars.com]]. The map had been drafted by [[Modi]],<ref name="EAOC" /> the chief mapmaker of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEA" />
